fusions.name: Torpor Dart
fusions.desc: Sends a dart of cold at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, with a 50% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Cold Snap
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 12 damage and is stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Stilled Moment
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tail Regrowth
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds and gain +10% dodge chance. Once every 40 seconds.
